Subject: POC trial planning & RACI - Sunrise Health

Hi Emily - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment. Please confirm or correct anything that I got wrong.

Call recap / Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Primary goal: Reduce triage time for intake tasks using generation model integrated into Sunrise's EHR workflow.
- Success metrics: 1) 95th percentile latency < 200ms for 1k qps test; 2) Top-1 accuracy on our label set >= 88%; 3) Human review load reduced by >= 30% during the 4-week trial.
- Trial window: 4 weeks, tentatively Sep 6 - Oct 3.
- Evaluation plan: Redwood provides a dedicated trial environment + sample dataset ingestion. Sunrise runs weekly evaluation checkpoints (week 1 baseline, week 2 integration sanity, week 3 performance tuning, week 4 final evaluation).

Ownership / RACI (first pass - please confirm):
- Infra/network: Sunrise infra (Ben Howard) - customer to provide VPC peering or VPN + required IP allowlist.
- App integration (EHR side): Sunrise product/engineering (Sarah Bennett) - implement integration hooks and sample data exports.
- Security / compliance: Sunrise security (Carlos Mendez) + Redwood security (Rishi) - mutual questionnaire and logs access plan.
- Procurement / contracting: Sunrise procurement (Joanne Kim) + Redwood legal/sales (Lauren) - finalize trial SOW and PO.

Immediate asks for next week:
1) Emily: confirm the stakeholders above and share contact for Carlos, Ben, Joanne, and Sarah so our team can loop them into the security and infra threads.
2) Emily: confirm trial start date (we proposed Sep 6) and any blackout dates.
3) Aditya: I've attached a POC checklist for technical prerequisites - can you review and add anything we missed? (attachment: redwood_poc_checklist.pdf)
4) Rishi: will start the security questionnaire - can you flag any Sunrise-specific requirements we should know about?

Thanks - I'll turn this into a one-page action list once I have confirmed stakeholders.

--

Thanks Marissa - quick technical notes from my side (adding to the checklist).

Infra prerequisites / notes (Redwood <> Sunrise):
- Network: We need either VPC peering (preferred) or a site-to-site VPN. IP allowlist for Redwood egress (we will provide IPs).
- Auth: SAML/OIDC integration for user-level access during the trial; API keys for model endpoints. If Sunrise prefers SAML, we'll coordinate with your IdP admin.
- Sample data: please provide a ~2k record sample dataset (de-identified) so we can pre-warm caches and run baseline evals.
- Data flow: ingestion -> Redwood trial endpoint -> webhook back to Sunrise for decisions. Confirm if webhooks can be exposed to a public endpoint or if we need private connectivity.
- Scale: for the trial we'll run a capped throughput test at 1k qps for latency profiling; if your infra team wants a lower initial cap we can adjust.

RACI suggestions (tech clarifications):
- Infra/network: Sunrise (Ben) - provide peering and firewall rules. Redwood (Aditya) - provide egress IPs, assist with peering setup.
- App integration: Sunrise Eng (Sarah) - implement webhook and data export; Redwood Eng - provide SDKs and support.
- Security: Redwood Sec (Rishi) - complete questionnaire and offer SOC2 artifacts; Sunrise Sec - provide any additional encryption/KMS requirements.
- Procurement/contracting: Sunrise Proc (Joanne) - issues PO; Redwood Sales (Marissa) + Legal (Lauren) - finalize SOW and trial terms.

I attached a quick infra checklist (infra_requirements.txt) with the exact ports, IP ranges, and expected certs. Happy to jump on a quick call with Ben and Sarah next week.

- Aditya

Marissa / Emily - tagging in from security. A few items I want to flag so we can keep the trial fast:

Security checklist / questions:
1) Data handling: Is the dataset fully de-identified? If not, we need to agree on encryption-in-transit + at-rest and a limited-access storage policy.
2) Audit logs: Sunrise needs read access to request/response logs for auditability? If yes, we can provide a secure shared bucket and a short retention window (configurable).
3) SOC2 / compliance: Redwood can share SOC2 report and system architecture diagram. Emily, please confirm who on your side should receive these artifacts.
4) Entitlements: For the trial we recommend scoped API keys with short TTLs and limited access scopes.

I'll draft the security questionnaire and attach the template for your team to review (security_questionnaire_template.xlsx). Emily - can you share Carlos Mendez's contact and whether Sunrise requires an in-person security review or a doc review is sufficient?

I'll aim to have the completed questionnaire back by Mon Aug 31 so we don't block the proposed Sep 6 start.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
